artifact_observations.reasoning: The metal rings appear to merge into the base plate without clear mechanical joints or screws. The geometry of the ring hinges looks physically implausible, with metal seeming to melt into the white plastic/metal base.
The blur pattern on the blue background is inconsistent with optical depth of field, showing slight 'smearing' or painterly textures rather than natural bokeh.
The right-most ring appears to warp slightly as it recedes, lacking the rigid straightness expected of steel wire, suggesting minor geometric instability.
